## ExecutionRequest.page property

The window of a list to read, present exactly when the operation pages (a list of a resource that has an identifier). Absent for every other operation, including a list that does not page, which reads its whole collection.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly page?: PageWindow;
```

## Remarks

When it is present, `execute` resolves to a [PageWindowResult](./core.pagewindowresult.md) instead of the array `outputPlan` describes. `input` then holds only the operation's other inputs: the runtime has already consumed the paging inputs and turned them into this window.
